description: View or set session defaults for recurring parameters (tab, timeout, …). Without params: show current defaults and auto-promote suggestions; autoPromote: true applies them. Set profile BEFORE any browser interaction to launch Chrome with a named profile.

defaults.description: Param name → default value; null removes a default

profile.description: Chrome profile name (list them with: public-browser profiles); restart: true switches mid-session

restart.description: Restart Chrome with the new profile even if running; closes all tabs

name: configure_session
